description.value: The Dayton Audio SS8-22 Signature Series 8" Subwoofer packs serious performance into a compact format, making it an ideal choice for small subwoofer systems where space is limited but output and accuracy are essential. Featuring a rigid anodized aluminum cone, dual-spider suspension, and a powerful triple-stacked motor assembly, the SS8-22 maintains precise pistonic motion and low distortion at high excursion. A 2.5" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former provides reliable cooling and allows the driver to handle up to 500 watts RMS with ease. Optimized for DSP-assisted sealed enclosures or compact vented/passive radiator systems, the SS8-22 is equally at home in home theater, hi-fi music systems, or car audio installs where clean, impactful bass from a small footprint is required. Product Highlights Massive triple-stacked magnet assembly provides motor strength and symmetry at high excursion Aluminum shorting sleeve, ring, and pole cap linearize inductance and reduce distortion Dual spider suspension with stitched tinsel leads ensures stability, durability, and precise motion 2.5" 4-layer copper voice coil on a vented aluminum former for excellent power handling and cooling Rigid anodized aluminum cone with indexed edge for pistonic accuracy and reduced resonance Extensive venting through cone, pole piece, spider, and gap minimizes compression during long sessions

model.value: SS8-22 8" Signature Series DVC Subwoofer 2 Ohms per Coil
